players.product: wafer-level burn-in systems (FOX) with WaferPak full-wafer contactors, and Sonoma package-level burn-in, for AI accelerators and silicon photonics

quarterly_data.quarter: Aehr Test Systems press release: Aehr Receives More Than $8 Million in New Silicon Carbide (07-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Aehr received more than $8 million in new silicon carbide wafer-level burn-in orders: a significant follow-on order for additional FOX WaferPak full-wafer contactors from its lead silicon carbide production customer (not named) to expand capacity for new electric vehicle platforms, particularly for the China EV market - the customer also indicated additional capacity requirements beyond this order in Aehr's current fiscal year - and an order placed directly by one of the largest automotive companies in the world (not named) for multiple WaferPaks used on Aehr's FOX systems to qualify silicon carbide devices from its suppliers for new-generation EVs. CEO Gayn Erickson sees 'the beginning of the next phase of growth' for this part of the business; Aehr is engaged with several of the largest automotive companies and several leading silicon carbide device makers evaluating wafer-level burn-in in production, and sees growing interest from silicon carbide applications including AI data center power systems.
quarterly_data.figure: more than $8 million in new silicon carbide wafer-level burn-in orders
